```{r}
# overleaf table of all

get_means <- function(var) {
  sample %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[var]] %in% c(0, 1)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[var]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        all_of(policy_vars),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group = var) %>%
    dplyr::rename(value = all_of(var)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(row = paste0(group, " = ", value)) %>%
    dplyr::select(row, all_of(policy_vars))
}

pol_means_app_table <- bind_rows(lapply(impact_vars, get_means)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-row, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(
    ~ policy_map$label[match(.x, policy_map$var)],
    -row
  )

View(pol_means_app_table)
```

Means Tables

```{r}
#defining the non impact means and percent differences from impact vars
pct_diff <- function(x, ref) {
  ((x - ref) / ref) * 100
}

policy_summary <- function(df, var) {

  no_impact_mean <- mean(
    df[[var]][df$impact == 0],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  impact_mean <- mean(
    df[[var]][df$impact == 1],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  direct_mean <- mean(
    df[[var]][df$incarc == 1],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  proximal_mean <- mean(
    df[[var]][df$knowincarc == 1],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  victim_mean <- mean(
    df[[var]][df$vict == 1],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    var = var,
    no_impact_mean = no_impact_mean,
    impact_diff = mean_diff(impact_mean, no_impact_mean),
    direct_diff = mean_diff(direct_mean, no_impact_mean),
    proximal_diff = mean_diff(proximal_mean, no_impact_mean),
    victim_diff = mean_diff(victim_mean, no_impact_mean)
  )
}


## old p val 

pval_ttest <- function(df, var, group_var) {
  sub <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[group_var]] %in% c(0, 1))

  if (length(unique(sub[[group_var]])) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  stats::t.test(sub[[var]] ~ sub[[group_var]])$p.value
}

add_star <- function(x, p) {
  ifelse(!is.na(p) & p < .05, paste0(sprintf("%.1f", x), "*"), sprintf("%.1f", x))
}

policy_stars <- policy_map %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_direct = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(sample, .x, "incarc")
    ),
    
    p_proximal = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(sample, .x, "knowincarc")
    ),
    
    p_victim = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(sample, .x, "vict")
    )
  )

# Mean differences relative to respondents reporting
# none of the three focal experiences
mean_diff <- function(x, ref) {
  x - ref
}

policy_summary <- function(df, var) {
  no_impact_mean <- mean(df[[var]][df$impact == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  impact_mean <- mean(df[[var]][df$impact == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  direct_mean    <- mean(df[[var]][df$incarc == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  proximal_mean  <- mean(df[[var]][df$knowincarc == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  victim_mean    <- mean(df[[var]][df$vict == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    var = var,
    no_impact_mean = no_impact_mean,
    impact_mean = pct_diff(impact_mean, no_impact_mean),
    direct_pct = pct_diff(direct_mean, no_impact_mean),
    proximal_pct = pct_diff(proximal_mean, no_impact_mean),
    victim_pct = pct_diff(victim_mean, no_impact_mean)
  )
}

policy_table <- purrr::map_dfr(
  policy_map$var,
  ~ policy_summary(sample, .x)
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(policy_map, by = "var") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    var, section, label,
    no_impact_mean,
    impact_mean,
    direct_diff,
    proximal_diff,
    victim_diff
  )

pval_ttest <- function(df, var, group_var) {
  sub <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[group_var]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[group_var]] %in% c(0, 1))
  
  if (length(unique(sub[[group_var]])) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  stats::t.test(
    sub[[var]] ~ sub[[group_var]]
  )$p.value
}

add_star <- function(x, p) {
  formatted <- sprintf("%+.2f", x)
  
  ifelse(
    !is.na(p) & p < .05,
    paste0(formatted, "*"),
    formatted
  )
}

policy_stars <- policy_map %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_direct = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(
        sample %>%
          dplyr::filter(impact == 0 | incarc == 1),
        .x,
        "incarc"
      )
    ),
    
    p_proximal = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(
        sample %>%
          dplyr::filter(impact == 0 | knowincarc == 1),
        .x,
        "knowincarc"
      )
    ),
    
    p_victim = purrr::map_dbl(
      var,
      ~ pval_ttest(
        sample %>%
          dplyr::filter(impact == 0 | vict == 1),
        .x,
        "vict"
      )
    )
  )

policy_table_final <- policy_table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    policy_stars %>%
      dplyr::select(var, p_direct, p_proximal, p_victim),
    by = "var"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    no_impact_mean   = sprintf("%.2f", no_impact_mean),
    direct_display   = add_star(direct_diff, p_direct),
    proximal_display = add_star(proximal_diff, p_proximal),
    victim_display   = add_star(victim_diff, p_victim)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    section,
    label,
    no_impact_mean,
    direct_display,
    proximal_display,
    victim_display
  )

View(policy_table_final)

# Generate rows for Overleaf
latex_rows <- policy_table_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    latex_row = paste0(
      label, " & ",
      no_impact_mean, " & ",
      direct_display, " & ",
      proximal_display, " & ",
      victim_display, " \\\\"
    )
  )

help_rows <- latex_rows %>%
  dplyr::filter(section == "Help") %>%
  dplyr::pull(latex_row)

punish_rows <- latex_rows %>%
  dplyr::filter(section == "Punish") %>%
  dplyr::pull(latex_row)

cat(
  paste(help_rows, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n\\addlinespace\n",
  paste(punish_rows, collapse = "\n"),
  sep = ""
)
```

### 2.1A Police Policy

```{r}

source("variable_labels.R")

police_items_1_to_5 <- c(
  "local_police",
  "no_strangle",
  "police_tracker",
  "police_training",
  "charge_police"
)

#avg check
sample <- sample %>%
  mutate(police_index = rowMeans(across(all_of(police_items_1_to_5)), na.rm = TRUE))

summary(sample$police_index)

# police index 1: index of all the police items
sample <- sample %>%
  mutate(
    police_reform_index = rowMeans(across(all_of(police_items_1_to_5)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# police index 2: index of the items that hang together best

police_reform_core <- c(
  "no_strangle",
  "police_tracker",
  "police_training",
  "charge_police"
)

sample <- sample %>%
  mutate(
    police_reform_core_index = rowMeans(across(all_of(police_reform_core)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# last - 3 groups 
sample <- sample %>%
  mutate(
    police_violence_prevention = rowMeans(across(c("no_strangle", "police_training")), na.rm = TRUE),
    police_accountability = rowMeans(across(c("police_tracker", "charge_police")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

## POLICE MEANS ANALYSIS 

# index 1: police_reform_index

## baseline: no impact
all_baseline_mean <- mean(
  sample$police_reform_index[sample$impact == 0],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

## compute means for each impact group
all_police_means <- tibble(
  var = impact_vars
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = impact_labels[var],
    mean = sapply(var, function(v) {
      mean(
        sample$police_reform_index[
          sample[[v]] == 1
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    })
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      var = "no_impact",
      label = "No impact",
      mean = all_baseline_mean
    ),
    .
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_from_no_impact = mean - all_baseline_mean
  )

all_police_means
```
